user_story: As a user, I want to reset my password via email so that I can regain access if I forget it.

positive.title: Successful password reset request
steps: Enter a valid registered email address
Check the email inbox for the password reset email
Click on the password reset link in the email
positive.expected_result: The password is successfully reset, and a confirmation message is displayed.

positive.title: Password reset email received
steps: Open the email with the password reset link
positive.expected_result: The password reset email is received and contains a valid reset link.

negative.title: Password reset request with unregistered email
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is not registered.

negative.title: Expired password reset link
steps: Wait for the reset link to expire
Click on the expired reset link
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the reset link has expired.

edge.title: Password reset request with email containing special characters
steps: Enter an email address with special characters (e.g., user.name+tag@example.com)
Check the email inbox for the password reset email
edge.expected_result: The password reset email is successfully sent, and a valid reset link is provided.

edge.title: Password reset with very long password
steps: Navigate to the password reset page via email link
Enter a password that exceeds the maximum length (e.g., 100 characters)
Confirm the password with the same long password
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the password is too long.
